summary: Initial complete independent chronology audit of all 61 Chinese units, 50 temporal or active-hint items, and 21 people in the Biography of Bo Yi. The source is largely philosophical and traditional narrative. It supports qualitative legendary context and undated deaths, but does not itself date the Grand Historian, Confucius, Yan Yuan, Robber Zhi, Master Jia, or the traditional conquest narrative. Eleven records contain inferred Western ranges or hints that must be removed without replacing them with invented precision.
